command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; set -uo pipefail does not clear it (spawn#707).
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
echo "d8f420b1eaf864c0f9c5f195d35cba1dc2966604b65dda132713ac96bc6f4353  compare.py" | sha256sum -c - || { echo "FAIL: compare.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
python3 -u compare.py /tmp/a /tmp/x /tmp/m > /tmp/compare.log 2>&1
RC=$?
cat /tmp/compare.log
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: compare failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'COMPARE OK' /tmp/compare.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
